video.proof: Show up and keep a streak

checked: the phone in Scene 1, Scene 2, Scene 3 and all 4 video shots matches the reference photo as the single device with screen toward camera
no visible AI faults, warped hands/faces, melted objects or gibberish text in any scene
overlay words, Try It button and 7 days free badge are readable and do not cover face or product in any scene
no avoid-list items in any scene - no gym machines, scales, food/diet, body-focused or before/after framing, text/logos in scene, other devices, or looking into lens
persona Parent of two early-morning moment and Early November indoor season look with warm lived-in light, sage/cream/wood palette holds in all scenes
the three still scenes and the 4 video shots (hook/benefit/proof/end card) tell one low-pressure start story and the storyboard follows them
copy and claims stay encouraging and plain with no hype, medical, weight-loss or #1 claims and match the kit offer
